title: RubricReviewer：从直接批评到客观全面的基于评分标准的同行评审
summary: RubricReviewer 是一个完全基于评分标准的 LLM 评审框架，将评分标准生成作为显式中间步骤，结合无训练代理 Scout 收集外部证据和人类对齐模型 Aligner 消费证据，生成更全面、更具区分度的评审，并对对抗性提示注入攻击具有最强鲁棒性。
summary_en: RubricReviewer is a fully rubric-driven LLM review framework that makes rubric generation an explicit intermediate step, combining a training-free agent (Scout) for evidence gathering and a human-aligned model (Aligner) for evidence consumption, producing more comprehensive and discriminative reviews with strong robustness against adversarial prompt injection.
